anchor_age: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); the pair is collapsed, so anchor_age is not exactly recoverable and a typed NULL is emitted.
anchor_year: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); min(year(Encounter.period.start)) is only an approximation, not exact, so anchor_year is not exactly recoverable and a typed NULL is emitted.
